    What is generative, and what is assumed?

    Generated: frame stations, member lengths, floor tiles, roof strips, perimeter wall slots, door and window substitutions, component identifiers, type grouping, quantities and comparison. Inputs create these parts algorithmically; the app does not switch between stored house models.

    Working assumptions: 600 mm layout cells, 1200 mm longitudinal frame stations, 2400 mm wall height, a level roof proxy, 90 mm visual posts and 120 mm visual beams. Width changes create new spanning-member types. The porch consumes one end frame bay. A long-side door occupies the first two wall cells, aligned with a frame bay. End doors occupy the two central cells, offset by half a cell on odd-width layouts. Windows fill front/back cells alternately, skipping the door.

    Not resolved: load paths, stability, connections, tolerances, material grades, thermal and moisture build-ups, roof slope and drainage, glazing specification, handling weights, ventilation, tools, manufacture, cost and Lithuanian site requirements. The floor is shown as a repeatable grid, not a verified floor system. Some component volumes touch or overlap at schematic interfaces; joint clearance is not checked.

    Dimensions: the 600 mm convention is an experimental software parameter, not a product decision. Enclosed area is outer-grid footprint, not usable internal area. The part model must be revised once a physical system is selected.

    Views: exploded positions are display offsets only. They are not an assembly sequence. Roof visibility and rotation never alter the generated schedule. The lightweight axonometric renderer uses approximate face ordering; inspect the frame, plan and exploded views together.

    Verification: 318 supported configurations and 18 unsupported opening combinations checked, plus six malformed inputs. View controls, selection, comparisons and JSON export tested with a simulated DOM. SVG model extents checked at 320 px. Complete browser rendering and accessibility testing remain outstanding.

    Continuity: this standalone experiment is separate from the released project package and existing Site. No data is sent anywhere. Download JSON to keep a model; a pinned reference lasts only while this page is open.
